RealGrader starts with a complimentary audit of your presence on Google, AI search and social media, and its plans add automated daily posting [1][2]. VEXI makes posts, videos, designs and captions from what you ask for. The two overlap on social media and start from different places.

RealGrader describes itself as a digital marketing system for trusted sales professionals [1].
